To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the quality of a tone-mapped image depends on the following image attributes: contrast, brightness, saturation, colorfulness, and noise; (2) the relationship between these attributes is: contrast > brightness > colorfulness > saturation > noise; (3) a high-quality tone-mapping operator should preserve contrast, brightness, and colorfulness; (4) a tone-mapping operator that preserves saturation and noise is not necessarily better than an operator that does not preserve these attributes
the following attributes are important for the evaluation of tone mapping operators: image sharpness, image contrast, image brightness, color appearance, and image quality.
